description: Create the Supabase PostgreSQL schema file and setup README. Pure SQL + docs artifact — independent of the TS code and has no build impact; it is the backend contract the auth and persistence features rely on, so it is ordered first. Columns must match src/types/index.ts snake_case exactly.
steps: Create d:\Development\Self\agenda-estudiantil\supabase\schema.sql. Enable pgcrypto/gen_random_uuid if needed. Define tables with snake_case columns matching src/types/index.ts: profiles(id uuid primary key references auth.users(id) on delete cascade, name text not null default '', email text, avatar_url text, role text not null default 'Estudiante', points int not null default 0, streak int not null default 0, created_at timestamptz not null default now()); tasks(id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(), user_id uuid not null references public.profiles(id) on delete cascade, title text not null, description text default '', subject text default '', priority text not null check (priority in ('urgente','importante','tiempo')), status text not null check (status in ('pendiente','en_progreso','completada')), due_date date, completed_at timestamptz, reminder_days_before int not null default 2, created_at timestamptz not null default now()); events(id uuid pk default gen_random_uuid(), user_id uuid not null references public.profiles(id) on delete cascade, title text not null, description text default '', date date, time text, color text, created_at timestamptz not null default now()); notes(id, user_id fk, title text, content text, created_at); goals(id, user_id fk, title text not null, description text default '', progress int not null default 0, completed boolean not null default false, target_date date, created_at); reminders(id, user_id fk, task_id uuid references public.tasks(id) on delete set null, title text not null, message text default '', remind_at timestamptz, active boolean not null default true, created_at); messages(id, sender_id uuid, receiver_id uuid, content text, type text check (type in ('text','audio')), created_at).

In schema.sql enable Row Level Security on every table (alter table ... enable row level security) and add per-operation policies: for profiles, policies using (id = auth.uid()) and with check (id = auth.uid()) for select/insert/update/delete; for tasks/events/notes/goals/reminders, policies using (user_id = auth.uid()) with check (user_id = auth.uid()); for messages, using (sender_id = auth.uid() or receiver_id = auth.uid()) and with check (sender_id = auth.uid()). Restrict to the authenticated role.

In schema.sql add the standard Supabase handle_new_user() function (returns trigger, language plpgsql, security definer, set search_path = public) that inserts into public.profiles (id, name, email) values (new.id, coalesce(new.raw_user_meta_data->>'name',''), new.email) on conflict (id) do nothing; and a trigger on_auth_user_created after insert on auth.users for each row execute function public.handle_new_user(). Add clear SQL section comments throughout.

Create d:\Development\Self\agenda-estudiantil\supabase\README.md with step-by-step instructions: open the Supabase dashboard, go to SQL Editor, paste the contents of schema.sql, run it; explain that the trigger auto-creates a profiles row on signup from auth metadata; mention Authentication > Providers email settings (and the option to disable email confirmation for local testing); state that the project .env already holds VITE_SUPABASE_URL and VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY (do NOT print or ask for the values).
acceptance_criteria: supabase/schema.sql exists and defines all 7 tables (profiles, tasks, events, notes, goals, reminders, messages) with snake_case columns identical to the interfaces in src/types/index.ts.

priority CHECK is ('urgente','importante','tiempo'), status CHECK is ('pendiente','en_progreso','completada'), reminder_days_before defaults to 2, role defaults to 'Estudiante', points/streak default 0.
RLS is enabled on every table and policies restrict rows to auth.uid() (profiles by id, others by user_id).
A handle_new_user() SECURITY DEFINER function and on_auth_user_created trigger auto-create the profiles row from raw_user_meta_data name + email.
supabase/README.md gives clear dashboard SQL-Editor run instructions and does not print any secret values.
verification: Confirm d:\Development\Self\agenda-estudiantil\supabase\schema.sql and supabase\README.md exist and column names match src/types/index.ts.
Run `npm run build` with cwd d:\Development\Self\agenda-estudiantil and confirm it still exits 0 (no TS changed, so the build must remain green).
findings:
Created supabase/schema.sql and supabase/README.md. Build (npm run build) exits 0, no TS changed. All 7 public-schema tables use snake_case columns identical to src/types/index.ts.

Final table/column names (schema = public):
- profiles(id uuid PK -> auth.users(id) on delete cascade, name text not null default '', email text, avatar_url text, role text not null default 'Estudiante', points int not null default 0, streak int not null default 0, created_at timestamptz not null default now()). Note: UserProfile has no user_id; its PK id == auth.uid().
- tasks(id uuid PK gen_random_uuid, user_id uuid not null -> profiles(id) cascade, title not null, description default '', subject default '', priority check in ('urgente','importante','tiempo'), status check in ('pendiente','en_progreso','completada'), due_date date, completed_at timestamptz, reminder_days_before int not null default 2, created_at timestamptz not null default now()).
- events(id, user_id FK, title not null, description default '', date date, time text, color text, created_at).
- notes(id, user_id FK, title default '', content default '', created_at).
- goals(id, user_id FK, title not null, description default '', progress int default 0, completed boolean default false, target_date date, created_at).
- reminders(id, user_id FK, task_id uuid -> tasks(id) on delete set null, title not null, message default '', remind_at timestamptz, active boolean default true, created_at).
- messages(id, sender_id uuid -> profiles(id) cascade, receiver_id uuid -> profiles(id) cascade, content default '', type check in ('text','audio'), created_at).

Date/timestamp conventions align with context: due_date/target_date/events.date are date columns (serialized 'yyyy-MM-dd'); completed_at/remind_at/created_at are timestamptz; events.time is text ('HH:mm'); events.color is text (hex).

RLS: enabled on all 7 tables, authenticated role only. Policy naming: <table>_<op>_own (profiles by id=auth.uid(); tasks/events/notes/goals/reminders by user_id=auth.uid()). messages: messages_select_participant (sender_id=auth.uid() OR receiver_id=auth.uid()), messages_insert_sender / messages_update_sender / messages_delete_sender (sender_id=auth.uid()).

Auto-profile: function public.handle_new_user() (returns trigger, plpgsql, security definer, set search_path=public) inserts into profiles(id,name,email) from new.id / coalesce(raw_user_meta_data->>'name','') / new.email, on conflict (id) do nothing. Trigger name: on_auth_user_created (after insert on auth.users, for each row). Script is idempotent (if not exists / create or replace / drop trigger if exists).
